title: Dump Truck and Utility Truck Phone Mounts
metaTitle: Dump Truck Phone Mount Guide | iBOLT Mounts
metaDescription: Suction cups and vent clips fail in rough vocational cabs. Learn which AMPS drill bases, locking cradles, and rail mounts hold up in dump trucks and
excerpt: Rough cab vibration, dirty surfaces, and gloved hands make standard phone mounts fail fast in dump trucks and utility trucks. Here is how to pick a setup that actually stays put.

spec.title: Dump Truck and Utility Truck Phone Mounts
spec.audience: dump truck drivers, utility contractors, municipal crews, and vocational fleet installers
spec.problem: Dump trucks and utility trucks have rougher cab vibration, dirtier interiors, more gloves and radios, and fewer clean mounting surfaces than commuter pickups.
spec.angle: Explain why long arms, light suction mounts, and vent clips struggle in rough vocational cabs, then show when AMPS drill-base, shorter arms, locking cradles, and rail clamps are better.
spec.comparisonFrame: RAM-style heavy-duty arms and balls can be excellent for severe-duty cabs, but buyers still need the right phone cradle and base. ProClip-style clean dash mounts can work in lighter vocational pickups, but rougher dump/utility cabs often need a fixed AMPS base. iBOLT fits when crews want locking phone holders, AMPS bases, and replacement parts in standard sizes.
